subject: Requirements & timeline: audit logs, retention, BYOK for Finity Health
messages:
From: Sarah Cole <sarah@finityhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:08 -0700
Subject: Feature requests: audit logs / retention / BYOK

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finity's security team reviewed the platform and surfaced three high-priority asks we need to close before procurement can move forward: 

1) Audit logs: must include per-token actor, request path, model variant, and masked prompt snippets. Retention: 24 months with export capability.
2) BYOK/KMS: customer-managed keys for model inputs/outputs at rest (not just control plane) — we need an architecture diagram and timeline to support FIPS-backed HSM.
3) SSO/SCIM: enable automatic user provisioning and admin role mapping; audit events must map to SAML names.

Attached is a short summary from our security team (finity_audit_requirements.pdf). Can you share an internal timeline and whether Redwood can commit to any of these within Q3? Also notify if you need an exception request for the procurement team.

Regards,
Sarah Cole
Head of Security
Finity Health

--

Subject: Re: Fwd: Finity - security asks (audit logs / BYOK / retention) -- triage

Thanks for the ping. High-level notes from infra/runtime: 

- Audit logs: we currently emit request-level traces (client id, route, model name, timestamps). We do not persist per-token actor or masked prompt snippets by default — adding token-level fields requires changes to the runtime logging path and could increase log volume ~3-5x depending on mask policy. Rough estimate: 3-4 engineer-weeks + storage/config work. We could ship a compressed export endpoint for full logs as an MVP.

- Retention: tiered retention is straightforward (hot: 90d, cold: 24 months) using object lifecycle policies. We need product to decide whether exports are self-serve or compliance-only and who bears egress costs for exports.

- BYOK/KMS: full at-rest encryption of data with customer keys in KMS is doable for storage blobs. FIPS/HSM-backed keys add procurement and operational overhead (partnering with customer KMS or HSM). Supporting keys that encrypt model KV cache/ephemeral GPU pages is much harder and may not be feasible without architectural changes. Timeline: storage-level BYOK MVP ~Q3 (6-8 weeks) if prioritized; deep integration (FIPS/HSM, runtime-level encryption) likely multi-quarter.

Open questions for Product/legal: 
1) Do we need to guarantee that prompts/snippets are reversible to customer for e-discovery?
2) What export SLA does sales want to promise?

I'll volunteer to scope a technical spike this week if PM can prioritize.

Vivek
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:08:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Finity - security asks (audit logs / BYOK / retention) -- triage

Thanks — agrees with Vivek's breakdown. Product position / proposed plan: 

1) Audit logs: ship an "Enhanced Audit Export" (MVP) by end of Q3. Export will contain masked prompt snippets (configurable masking level) and token-level metadata but not raw tokens by default. We will provide a compressed export and a preview UI for admins.

2) Retention: offer configurable retention tiers (90d, 1yr, 2yr) selectable per account in Dedicated. Exports available on demand. Egress charges apply to the customer by default; sales can request credit exceptions.

3) BYOK: prioritize storage-level BYOK in Q3 (customer-managed keys for object store and control plane metadata). Deeper runtime/HSM integration to be explored in Q4+ as a paid professional services engagement. Recommend we offer a "security checklist" doc and a timeline to Finity now and open a PM/Eng JIRA (SECINFRA-482).

Action items: 
- Karthik: scope product requirements and UX for export UI and retention options (due 6/14).
- Vivek: run the spike to validate token-level logging impact and provide engineering estimate (due 6/11).
- Marcus: draft a short procurement-friendly statement about BYOK/limitations for Legal review (due 6/10).
- Neha: align with Finity and confirm if they need an exceptions letter for procurement.

I'll add these items to roadmap planning and flag to leadership. If we can promise the export MVP and storage-level BYOK for Q3, that should unblock the procurement path.

Laura
Senior Product Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah@finityhealth.com>
Cc: Finity Legal <legal@finityhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feature requests: audit logs / retention / BYOK

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the detailed notes — appreciate the clear asks. Internal triage completed; below is our proposed, near-term plan and next steps: 

Summary of what we can commit (near-term / Q3):
- Enhanced Audit Export (MVP): compressed export including token-level metadata and configurable masking of prompt snippets. Target: end of Q3.
- Retention tiers: Dedicated accounts will be able to select 90d / 1yr / 2yr retention; exports available on demand.
- Storage-level BYOK: customer-managed keys for object store and control plane metadata in Q3 (will support common KMS providers; FIPS/HSM-specific integrations will be scoped separately).

What remains under evaluation (Q4+):
- Runtime-level encryption of in-memory caches / GPU pages and direct HSM integration — we have logged this as SECINFRA-482 and will provide a follow-up by end of Q4.

Requested confirmation from Finity:
1) Can Finity accept masked prompt snippets in the export by default, with a signed process to request deeper data if legally required?
2) Will Finity cover egress costs for exports or should Sales request a procurement credit?

Attachments: I attached our internal triage notes and the Finity summary for reference. If this plan works, I'll prepare a short procurement-facing letter and timeline that you can share with your procurement/legal teams.

Next steps: please let me know by EOD Wed 6/9 so we can lock dates into the Q3 plan.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
